meta.name: Kardesim Benim
meta.description: Two resentful, singer brothers Hakan and Ozan who can't get along well. Meet again in their father's funeral. Even though they want to get back to their daily lives after the funeral, their father's will won't allow it.  They will take a journey with their dead father's old car in order to carry out his bequest which is to sing at a wedding in Urla.
